channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran FM says US outreach a ‘positive step’ as delegation in Qatar for talks
item.description: Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi tells Al Jazeera Tehran doesn't rule out attack, is ‘prepared for all scenarios’.

item.title: Iran lawmakers call for withdrawal from NPT: Will we have war or peace?
item.description: Withdrawal from the nuclear treaty doses not mean that Iran would build a nuclear weapon, observers say.

item.title: Iran warns of unfettered retaliation if attacked as mediators try for peace
item.description: Iran’s supreme leader says Tehran’s potential response will not be restricted by geography.
